description: Known-good and known-bad replies for checking the judge itself (node eval/grade.mjs --selftest). Each oracle is a hand-written reply that meets every required fact and none of the forbidden ones, so it must pass. Each case is also graded with its oracle plus a forbidden statement (must fail as a violation), an empty reply, 'I don't know.', and the other case's oracle (a confident answer to the wrong enquiry); all of those must fail.

oracle.subject: Re: Outside tap
oracle.body:
Hi Sian,

Thanks for getting in touch. Fitting an outside tap on the back wall costs £140–£190, including the tap and fittings. As Yate (BS37) is in our extended area, there is also a £25 travel charge.

We work Saturday mornings between 9am and 1pm. Which Saturday suits you best? We'll confirm a time as soon as we hear back.

Best wishes,
The Harbourline team

cases.violation: Good news: there's no travel charge for Yate.

oracle.subject: Re: Your bathroom refit quote Q-2026-0142
oracle.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for coming back to us, and no problem at all. Your quote Q-2026-0142 for the walk-in shower refit is £8,400 and is valid until 20 November 2026. To book the work we take a 25% deposit, which would be £2,100.

If you'd rather confirm in the new year, we would need to reconfirm the price then, as material costs can change. Happy to talk through timing whenever suits you.

Best wishes,
The Harbourline team

cases.violation: We'll happily hold the £8,400 price for you into the new year.
